mapper.insert: INSERT INTO settle_file ( file_no, task_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, file_name, file_size, file_md5, storage_bucket, storage_path, version, status ) VALUES ( #{fileNo}, #{taskNo}, #{settleDate}, #{memberId}, #{fileType}, #{fileName}, #{fileSize}, #{fileMd5}, #{storageBucket}, #{storagePath}, #{version}, #{status} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE file_no = VALUES(file_no), task_no = VALUES(task_no), file_name = VALUES(file_name), file_size = VALUES(file_size), file_md5 = VALUES(file_md5), storage_bucket = VALUES(storage_bucket), storage_path = VALUES(storage_path), status = VALUES(status)
mapper.select: SELECT id, file_no, task_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, file_name, file_size, file_md5, storage_bucket, storage_path, version, status, publish_time, revoke_time, reissue_time, status_reason, download_count, created_at, updated_at FROM settle_file WHERE file_no = #{fileNo}

SELECT id, file_no, task_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, file_name, file_size, file_md5, storage_bucket, storage_path, version, status, publish_time, revoke_time, reissue_time, status_reason, download_count, created_at, updated_at FROM settle_file WHERE settle_date = #{settleDate} AND member_id = #{memberId} AND file_type = #{fileType} AND version = #{version}

SELECT id, file_no, task_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, file_name, file_size, file_md5, storage_bucket, storage_path, version, status, publish_time, revoke_time, reissue_time, status_reason, download_count, created_at, updated_at FROM settle_file WHERE settle_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY settle_date DESC, member_id ASC, file_type ASC, version ASC

SELECT id, file_no, task_no, settle_date, member_id, file_type, file_name, file_size, file_md5, storage_bucket, storage_path, version, status, publish_time, revoke_time, reissue_time, status_reason, download_count, created_at, updated_at FROM settle_file WHERE status = 'PUBLISHED' AND (file_md5 IS NULL OR file_md5 = '' OR file_size IS NULL OR file_size <= 0 OR storage_bucket IS NULL OR storage_bucket = '' OR storage_path IS NULL OR storage_path = '') ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT old_file.id, old_file.file_no, old_file.task_no, old_file.settle_date, old_file.member_id, old_file.file_type, old_file.file_name, old_file.file_size, old_file.file_md5, old_file.storage_bucket, old_file.storage_path, old_file.version, old_file.status, old_file.publish_time, old_file.revoke_time, old_file.reissue_time, old_file.status_reason, old_file.download_count, old_file.created_at, old_file.updated_at FROM settle_file old_file WHERE old_file.status = 'REISSUED' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM settle_file new_file WHERE new_file.settle_date = old_file.settle_date AND new_file.member_id = old_file.member_id AND new_file.file_type = old_file.file_type AND new_file.version > old_file.version ) ORDER BY old_file.id ASC
